Claims remain bounded to RRC operator-reported production data and reporting limitations plus EIA dated commodity-data series. None is converted into a property-specific input, price deck, forecast, title fact, ownership fact, payment entitlement, appraisal, offer analysis, or value.

The article supplies no proprietary, universal, market, or owner-specific numerical assumptions; invents no owner, record, model output, public-record match, acreage, decimal, offer, or development result; and makes no owner-specific legal, tax, title, valuation, engineering, financial, or transaction conclusion.

sources_inspected.label: Railroad Commission of Texas, Production Data (accessed 2026-08-22)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The Railroad Commission of Texas describes production-data compilations and summaries based on information reported by Texas oil and gas operators and provides current and historical query routes.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article uses the page only to identify the reporting source and query context; it does not treat operator-reported production as ownership, title, acreage, payment, valuation, or forecast evidence.

sources_inspected.label: Railroad Commission of Texas, Production Data Query System FAQs (accessed 2026-08-22)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The Railroad Commission explains that Production Data Query reports lease-level information, recent data have a reporting lag, reported data may be revised, and the latest months are not yet substantially complete.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article preserves the agency limitations and requires exact identifiers, reporting period, access date, and unresolved matching questions; it makes no owner-specific production or title conclusion.

sources_inspected.label: U.S. Energy Information Administration, Oil Spot Prices (accessed 2026-08-22)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The U.S. Energy Information Administration publishes dated public oil spot-price observations and identifies their series and periods.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article uses the page only as an example of a specifically identified dated public series; it does not convert a spot observation into a property-specific price deck, forecast, realized price, or value.
